unity.label: Unity Concord
unity.summary: PLACEHOLDER (F-11, LSB backport candidate, not started). LSB-only. Unity Concord NPCs, unity warps, accolades, Unity quest menu and leader rankings; joining requires 10 completed Records of Eminence, so it is blocked on the ROE domain. LSB: scripts/globals/unity.lua, sql/unity_system.sql, packets 0x110/0x116-0x118/0x063 (DSP's 0x110 is an unrelated handler). Needs a client-version check and verified event ids before any build.
unity.compare: Depends on ROE. Verify every csid against a fresh same-session DAT pull before marking anything ok.
